summary: Name the exact call each native prompt asks about, so clients offer to allow only that call

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: prompt.respond's action_parameters gain call_id: the tool use (Claude) or item (Codex) id the prompt asks about, or null when the harness did not name it; daemons before it omit the field, and clients keep their earlier rule for them. A Codex seat whose driver predates this build names no call, so its approvals are allowed in the terminal until it restarts.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
